vakitler.title: Times
vakitler.surahOrderTitle: Quranic Order of Surahs in Prayer
vakitler.surahOrderIntro: When reciting a surah after Al-Fatiha, following the order of the Quran (from beginning to end) is sunnah. The short surahs most often recited in prayer are ordered as follows:

notes.fardFour: In four-rak'ah fard prayers, a surah is not recited after Al-Fatiha in the 3rd and 4th rak'ahs.
notes.fardThree: In the three-rak'ah fard prayer, a surah is not recited after Al-Fatiha in the 3rd rak'ah.
notes.fardTwo: In the fard of Fajr, a surah is recited after Al-Fatiha in both rak'ahs.
notes.lastSunnah: The last sunnah is prayed like a regular two-rak'ah sunnah.
notes.sunnahFour: In a four-rak'ah sunnah, a surah is also recited after Al-Fatiha in the 3rd and 4th rak'ahs.
notes.witr: Witr is three rak'ahs and is wajib. In the 3rd rak'ah, after Al-Fatiha and a surah, the hands are raised with takbir and the Qunut dua is recited.
